ctgov.note: Sponsor query used Leap Therapeutics; all R&D wound down per 10-K

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per 2025 10-K (filed 2026-03-16): On June 23, 2025 the Board approved completion of the DeFianCe clinical trial and a full wind-down of R&D activities (sirexatamab/DKN-01 and FL-501 programs). Company also executed a ~75% workforce reduction (CMO/COO/CSO/CMfO departed). On November 12, 2025 the company renamed from Leap Therapeutics to Cypherpunk Technologies Inc., changed ticker LPTX -> CYPH, and pivoted to a Zcash (ZEC) digital asset treasury strategy. ~90% of total assets are now digital assets receivable held at Gemini. Therapeutic R&D continues only as a small wholly-owned Leap subsidiary with no active enrolling P1/P2/P3 trials.

excluded_preclinical.stage: Preclinical; program wound down per June 2025 restructuring

excluded_legacy_terminated.status: All clinical trials completed and program wound down per June 2025 restructuring
